title: Build a filtered pagination response
summary: A REST list endpoint filters records, sorts the matching results, and returns one page plus pagination metadata. Implement the data transformation as a pure function without an HTTP server or database. Implement the pure data logic behind a typical REST list endpoint.
requirements: records is an array of objects with id and status fields; status is a string.
If statusFilter is null, include all records; otherwise keep only exact matches.
page and pageSize are integers, page >= 1, and pageSize is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Throw an Error containing "Invalid pagination" for invalid page or pageSize.
Return { items, page, pageSize, total, totalPages }, preserving original item order.
total counts filtered records; totalPages is Math.ceil(total / pageSize), including 0 for no records.
Return empty items for a page beyond the last page.
hints: Apply the status filter before counting and slicing.
